summary: Configured node1 as an NFSv4 server and mounted its shared export on node2 and node3. Bidirectional file visibility, ownership, and permissions were verified.
actions_performed: Installed nfs-kernel-server on node1 and nfs-common on both clients.
Created sharedops with UID/GID 4200 on all three nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared read-write only to node2 and node3, with root squashing and NFSv3 disabled.
Set /srv/nfs/shared ownership to sharedops:sharedops and mode 2770.
Mounted the export persistently at /mnt/shared on node2 and node3 using NFSv4.2.
Created files from both clients and verified them from the opposite client and server.

evidence.requirement: Shared identity uses UID and GID 4200 on all systems
evidence.summary: All three nodes report sharedops as uid=4200 and gid=4200.

evidence.requirement: node1 provides the correctly secured NFSv4 export
evidence.summary: nfs-server is active and enabled; NFSv3 is disabled while v4/v4.1/v4.2 are enabled; /srv/nfs/shared is exported read-write only to 10.100.169.11 and .12 and has ownership 4200:4200 with mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: Both clients mount the export at /mnt/shared over the storage network
evidence.summary: node2 and node3 have live and persistent NFSv4.2 mounts from 10.100.169.10:/srv/nfs/shared at /mnt/shared.

evidence.requirement: Files created by either client are immediately visible from the other with retained ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: node2 created a 0640 file and node3 immediately read it as sharedops:sharedops (4200:4200); node3 created a 0660 file and node2 immediately read it with the same ownership and mode.
